## Title (Conventional Commits)

Use the PR title as the squash-merge commit message:

```
type(scope): short imperative description
```

Examples: `feat(agent): add geography filter`, `fix(api): handle empty ACS response`, `docs: update architecture guide`

Allowed types: `build`, `ci`, `docs`, `feat`, `fix`, `perf`, `refactor`, `style`, `test`, `chore`
